title: CLOSINGBALANCEMONTH evaluates the expression on the last date of the month
query: EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE ( ROW ( "r", CLOSINGBALANCEMONTH ( [Sales], 'Date'[Date] ) ), 'Date'[Date] >= DATE ( 2024, 2, 1 ) && 'Date'[Date] <= DATE ( 2024, 2, 29 ) )

source.supports: the definition: the expression on the last date of the month

derivation: The last date of February 2024 is the 29th; sales on that date are 400 (the month total is 700).
